hkv: אַשְׁרֵי תְמִימֵי דָרֶךְ הַהֹלְכִים בְּתוֹרַת ה'
tr: Happy are those whose way is perfect, who walk in the Torah of Hashem.

s.t: The Power of Torah to Elevate Grace
s.sum: Through Torah study, one's grace and importance are elevated before all who are needed, whether in spiritual or material matters.

s.t: Contemplating the Intellect in Every Matter
s.sum: A person must always contemplate the intellect present in every matter and connect to the wisdom within it.

s.t: Jacob as Intellect, Esau as Rejection of Intellect
s.ht: יַעֲקב בְּחִינַת שֵׂכֶל, עֵשָׂו בְּחִינַת בִּזּוּי שֵׂכֶל
s.sum: Jacob represents the aspect of intellect (receiving the birthright), while Esau represents despising the intellect.

s.t: The Connection of Chet and Nun Forms Grace
s.sum: The letter Chet (wisdom, intellect) and Nun (kingship, malchut) combine to form Chen (grace).

s.t: Torah as Rods Engraved with Names
s.sum: The Torah is like rods engraved with divine names, through which the evil inclination is subdued.
